name: agentarmy-board-sync
description: Board-sync runtime (ARC-ADR-036): applies a PROVEN, VENDED field adapter to live work items from a board system (GitHub Projects v2 wired live; Linear sample-ready) and emits canonical WorkItems. No embedder/abstraction-service at runtime — the adapter was discovered, escalated, and validated at build time by the abstraction meta-service and baked into adapters/. The thin runtime consumer half of the meta-service; feeds the Holonic Unified Board (#334).

env.GH_TOKEN: (optional) GitHub token; else resolved from akv:GithubPAT

shims.note: GitHub fetch uses stdlib urllib (no httpx). azure-* only for resolving GithubPAT from Key Vault when GH_TOKEN is not in env.

baked.purpose: apply_adapter(adapter, payload) -> canonical WorkItem via the vended {canonical: source_field} map; missing_required() gate.
github_v2_items() — live Projects v2 GraphQL fetch flattened to the adapter's source-field shape; token from GH_TOKEN or akv:GithubPAT. Linear connector is sample-ready (no key).
Proves the vended adapters turn GitHub v2 + Linear items into the SAME canonical WorkItem with required fields present (sample mode, no docker/keys needed).
VENDED field adapter for GitHub Projects v2 -> canonical WorkItem (trusted maps only; produced by the abstraction meta-service).
VENDED field adapter for Linear -> canonical WorkItem (snapped).

doctor.description: Applies the vended adapters to bundled GitHub v2 + Linear samples and asserts each yields a canonical WorkItem with Identifier/Title/Status present and a unified shared shape. Live-verified separately: a REAL AgentArmy Projects v2 item (token from akv:GithubPAT) normalized to a runtime-safe canonical WorkItem.

deploy.notes: Runs as an ACA job/worker (entrypoint 'sync') on a schedule or trigger, pulling live board items and emitting canonical WorkItems to the Holonic Unified Board (#334). 'doctor' mode is the correctness gate.

contract.note: Consumes a vended field adapter (the abstraction meta-service's output) and the canonical WorkItem shape; produces canonical WorkItems for the board.
